Strict forward descendant of start HEAD `198ab4c231c6399c46dedae4d300bb044c350f7d`. One new forward commit; clean worktree; no amend. Metadata/install repairs preserved (`engines.node` remains `>=20` in package.json and package-lock.json).

## Root cause fixed
`promoteStageAtomically` claimed the final name with `mkdir(dest)` then moved entries one-by-one (manifest last). That method family (`472a05e`) exposed empty/partial final directories to observers, left crash residue at the final path mid-loop, and is not a single kernel-atomic no-replace publication of the complete staged tree.

## Green implementation
- New seam helper `src/recorder/rename-no-replace.ts` + N-API binding (`scripts/rename_no_replace.c` → `dist/recorder/rename_no_replace.node`) calling Darwin `renamex_np(RENAME_EXCL)` / Linux `renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE)`.
- `promoteStageAtomically` now revalidates containment + same-FS, then publishes the whole stage in one no-replace rename. Occupied names (file/dir/symlink/empty dir) map to `destination-exists` without mutating the contested final name; other errors map to `promotion-failed`. Success transfers stage ownership; failure cleans only the private stage.
- Required raw cleanup still runs before publication. No production fault hooks. `npm run build:recorder` compiles TS then the native binding (stderr-only log so `npm pack --json` stays clean).
